about: Per-producer PR WIP limits and idle expiry. A producer (the branch prefix before the first '/') may not open a new PR, and a lane may not claim a new issue, while it owns cap or more open, unheld PRs. Little's law: cap = the producer's merges per day x a 1-day target lead time, floored at minCap. Measured 2026-11-01 from the last 3 days of merges (fleet 96/day against 391 open, +69/day net growth). Retune here, not in code; pr_wip.py and pr-open.mjs both read this file.

expire.about: Off until JOV-INV-011 (automaticCloseRequiresExplicitDuplicateLabel) is amended by the founder; until then `python3 scripts/lanes/pr_wip.py expire` lists candidates and `--apply` is an explicit, authorized run.
